labels.notes: Not a certification target: the row stays partial and unmarked, and the module carries no **`label`** mark (the ledger regex tools/ledger.py:254 needs prefix:label; the three **`…`** spans at :61, :224, :431 are not labels). THE SEPARATION IS GENUINE. I checked each binder of Causal.ers_theorem_4_82_solution_of_restarts (Causal/Ers482Solution.lean:558) and _of_restarts_isCausal (:582), elaborated at M = β = ℝ, sol = sol82, cau = cauSep, S = {0}, s₀ = 0, U₁ = ersWitnessIoo, u₁ = id, against the conjuncts of restart_separation (scaffold/CausalScaffold/Ers482RestartSeparation.lean:360), using a MetaM probe (deleted afterwards). Results: hloc, hglue, hres ↔ conjuncts 1–3; hs₀, hmax, honesided, hconn, hG, hT, hcaus, hsplit, hJm, hJp, hK, hSclosed, hagree ↔ conjuncts 4–16; the conclusion ↔ conjunct 17; conjunct 18 ↔ ¬ (the hrestart binder). Every pair is defeq at reducible transparency. Where the terms were not syntactically equal, the only difference was an unsynthesised OfNat instance metavariable in my probe's own elaboration of ({0} : Set ℝ). So the last conjunct negates exactly hrestart: same quantifier order (U₀ u₀ U₂ u₂), both IsDevelopment premises, SliceRestart for (cauSep u₂) on U₂ with A = connectedComponentIn (U₀ ∩ U₂) 0, Q = GluedRestartAt cauSep {0} U₀ U₂ u₀ u₂ A. restart_separation_forms really applies both forms to the destructured conjuncts. Probe.lean's example additionally types one hr by both forms and feeds it to the negated conjunct. (b) cauSep : (ℝ → ℝ) → Causality ℝ, each value timelikeLine or spacelikeLine. sol82_local, sol82_glue, sol82_restricts are the graduated Ers482Witness lemmas. The hypotheses are not vacuous: (]-1,1[, id), (dom₀, mark ½), (dom₂, mark ⅕) are developments. (c) not_gluedRestartAt_pair (:289): both are IsDevelopment, neither is maximal, ¬ dom₂ ≤ dom₀. 1/10 ∈ frontier A ∩ dom₂, and IsSpacelikeBoundaryPoint holds for cauSep (mark ⅕) on dom₂ relative to {0} with B = frontier A: this is exactly SliceRestart's premise (ErsUniqueness.lean:211), in the future disjunct. GluedRestartAt (Ers482Solution.lean:176) is refuted at V = dom₂, a V it quantifies over: dom₂ ∈ 𝓝 (1/10), dom₂ ⊆ U₂, and dom₂ ∩ dom₀ = A. The glued function is glueSolutions dom₀ (mark ½) (mark ⅕), the one GluedRestartAt reads. Its causality is the spacelike line (cauSep_glue₀₂: x on ]-1/2, 1/5[, 7 off it; I re-derived the 1/2, -3/10, 1/4 evaluations by hand). (d) spacelikeLine_subset_of_isCauchySurfaceOn (:92) is correct: a spacelike-line causal curve is constant by CausalCurveIn.le_of_le and spacelikeLine_le, so the inextensible curve through x meets S at x. It is general, in namespace Causal, and named in the house style (spacelikeLine_le, timelikeLine_isCauchySurfaceOn_Ioo). No clash in any Lean package, nor with Causal.spacelikeLine_causalCurveOn_eq (Causal/InextensibleNotLeNested.lean:190). CausalityFollows: not_causalityFollows_cauSep prints as ¬ Causal.CausalityFollows cauSep (ErsMughd.lean:200), the library's predicate. The heq on dom₂ and the 0 ≤ 1/10 split are correct. The on-the-line survival claim is marked 'argued, not proved' in the SCOPE (:66–69) and in REPORT causality_follows.survives, findings[2], questions[0] and what_remains. OQ-156 stays OPEN (registers/DECISIONS.md:384); 'Reading taken: none'. The SCOPE's reduction sentence (:64–66: with CausalityFollows the glued solution is u₁ on U₀ ∪ U₂, so the restart reads cau u₁ only) is stated as fact. It is not in Lean, but I checked it: IsCauchySurfaceOn W reads only ≤_N for N ≤ W (CurveOn, Curves.lean:69–73), and the conclusion gives u₀ = u₁ on U₀ and u₂ = u₁ on U₂. The argued step (W = ]a₀, b₀+ε[ is Cauchy) is plausible: monotone curves on ℝ and S a singleton make uniqueness automatic. The REPORT correctly names the concatenation step as the missing piece. Paper: the REPORT makes no claim against ERS (findings[3]: 'Paper: none'). The quotes at ghd_02_19.tex:1106 and :1138 are verbatim.
